subject: INSPECT statement
notes: kb/Work PB1128 (landed w66k). GR2 a)-c): a zero-length identifier-1 leaves identifier-1 AND identifier-2 unchanged and control goes immediately to the end of the statement. InspectEmitter.Emit reads identifier-1's image once and wraps every pass and the write-back in `if (image.Length != 0)`, so the tallying pass no longer runs counter := counter + 0 (an arithmetic store that re-encoded a non-canonical counter image: '7 ' in a PIC 99 came back '07'). Witness N9: ZG's table at count 0, CG holding '7 ' reads '7 ' after INSPECT ZG TALLYING C2 FOR CHARACTERS.
